name: revit-mcp
description: Query and edit the Autodesk Revit model open on this computer.
long_description: Connects Claude to Revit 2025-2027 through the Revit MCP add-in, which must be installed in Revit separately (install.ps1 in the release archive). Reading is always available; changing the model works only after the user turns on 'Allow changes' on the Revit MCP ribbon panel. Communication uses a per-user named pipe: no network ports are opened and nothing leaves the computer.

read_only.title: Read-only
read_only.description: Hide every tool that changes the model, regardless of the 'Allow changes' switch in Revit.
